title: changeset: the #31037 changeset declares `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` / spec patch for adding `delete_package` to the platform tool-name registry, which widens what a skill `tools[]` may name
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ① a wrong declaration on an unreleased changeset, found by the post-hoc spec review #31467 (`Reviewed:` line on that card for PR #31037 / #31020).
Reader: the `domain:spec` lane. The fix is one edit to `.changeset/cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md`, which is still on `main` (unconsumed), so it must land before the next release cut. Triage grades it; the seat suggests p1 (release-bound).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "delete_package Clause" → #31020 (closed, the source), #31040 (closed, the lint pin), #31025 (open, Studio delete, unrelated).
reach: the release notes and the semver of `@objectstack/spec`. A skill whose `tools[]` names `delete_package` was refused by the ADR-0109 lint before and is accepted now (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`, read at `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts:35`, and the MCP runtime). That is an accept-set widening shipped as an undeclared patch.
type: Bug

## Readings

- `.changeset/cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md` declares `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- The same registry's earlier additions declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` + `Metadata-protocol: added` at minor: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` ≈L537-540 (`read_package_doc`) and ≈L2347-2350 (`draft_record`).

## Ask

- Change the spec changeset to `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`. Keep the body as it is; it already describes the widening.
- No code change. A contract review is not owed for a declaration-only correction; the seat checks the lines in its ACCEPT.
